name: case_annotations_preserve_source_retrieval
oracle_basis: Source search must retain native passage slots when named case annotations are mapped. Original and transfer use distinct topics; the control has no analytical mapping.

original.source:
let db = @@GRAPH@@
let raw = graph_ingest(db,{"schema": "loom.graph.batch.v1", "batch_id": "seed", "nodes": [{"id": "s", "type": "source", "origin": "synthetic:case-control", "locator": "test:1"}, {"id": "paper", "type": "passage", "label": "Source document", "text": "The budget revision was recorded in the retained document.", "source_ids": ["s"]}]}, {"evolution": false})
let mapped = graph_case_map(db,{"batch_id": "mapped", "reviewer": "Synthetic test", "expected_revision": 1, "mappings": [{"id": "summary", "episode": "test", "kind": "statement", "summary": " budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision budget revision", "context": {}, "evidence": [{"node_id": "paper", "start": 0, "end": 58, "quote": "The budget revision was recorded in the retained document."}]}]})
expect graph_hybrid_search(db,"budget revision", {"top":1})["hits"][0]["id"] == "paper"
